description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores between two different tokenization methods for materials data, as a function of the number of tokens. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," is a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.5, with tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," is also a linear scale ranging from 48 to 58, with tick labels at 48, 52, 56, and 58. The plot features two lines: one in pink, representing the "MATTER (ours)" method, and one in purple, representing the "w/o material information" method. The pink line starts at approximately 56% for 0.6 tokens, peaks at around 58% for 1.0 tokens, and ends at about 52% for 1.5 tokens. The purple line starts at around 52% for 0.6 tokens, has a slight peak at 54% for 1.0 tokens, and ends at approximately 48% for 1.5 tokens. Both lines show fluctuations in the Macro-F1 score as the number of tokens increases, with the "MATTER (ours)" method generally maintaining a higher score than the "w/o material information" method.
